question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2
solution:
The correct answer is **"Awards".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• *'Not a year passes without a controversy over the national sports **awards. **The debate that arises every year following the announcement of the (2)__________ often leads to accusations of bias, regionalism and manipulations.*' As in this opening sentence, we are sure that this is all about** 'Awards'.**
 
• So, in the second fill-up the most appropriate word is** 'awards'.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 2.**

**Hence, the correct passage will be-** *Not a year passes without a controversy over the national sports awards. The debate that **arises** every year following the announcement of the **awards **often leads to accusations of bias, regionalism, and manipulations. (3)___________ to the Sports Minister and Chief Ministers and (4)___________by the politicians have all become part of the (5)_____________. *
